# Color Picker

> A color picker with a saturation and brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, a hex field and swatches.

`<slab-color-picker>` · Form · built on `<input type=range>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/color-picker/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/color-picker.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-color-picker
  label="Fill"
  name="fill"
  value="#3399ff"
  swatches="#ff0000 #00ff00 #0000ff"
  alpha
></slab-color-picker>
```

Each thumb holds a visually hidden range input, named by `label` and then its own label, so a screenreader reads "Fill Hue". It's what has focus and what a screenreader reads, which lets screenreaders on phones adjust it with a swipe up or down. The area's input is its saturation, and its value text reads both of its values, "Saturation 60%, Brightness 100%". The area has a second input for its brightness, "Fill Brightness", which is left out of the tab order since the arrow keys already change both. Give the area and the sliders a size, since their thumbs are placed along them. The form gets `value` under `name`.

Since a thumb isn't focused itself, it can't match `:focus-visible`. Style its focus ring through `::part(focus-visible)`, which the thumb has while its input's focus is visible.

The hex field commits when it's blurred or Enter is pressed, with or without the "#", and goes back to `value` when what's typed isn't a color. The swatches are a listbox whose selection follows focus.

Every color is a valid value, so it's never invalid on its own. For a rule of your own, such as enough contrast with a background, call `setCustomValidity()` with a message. It shows in `::part(validity-message)`, and the host matches `:state(error)`, once validity is reported, as on [Text Field](text-field.md): when focus leaves the picker, when its form is submitted, or on `reportValidity()`.

## Keyboard

| Key                   | What it does                                                                                  |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Left, Right           | In the area, steps saturation. On a slider, steps it. Each moves the thumb the way it points. |
| Down, Up              | In the area, steps brightness. On a slider, steps it.                                         |
| Page Up, Page Down    | In the area, steps brightness by 10. On a slider, steps it by a tenth.                        |
| Home, End             | In the area, moves saturation to 0 or 100. On a slider, moves it to either end.               |
| Left, Down, Right, Up | In the swatches, moves to the previous or next swatch and selects it.                         |
| Home, End             | In the swatches, moves to the first or last swatch and selects it.                            |
| Enter                 | In the hex field, commits it.                                                                 |

## Elements

### `<slab-color-picker>`

Import `slab-elements/color-picker.js` to register it.

A color picker with no visual styles: a two-dimensional area for saturation and brightness, a hue slider, an optional alpha slider, a hex field, and optional swatches.

`value` is a lowercase hex color, "#rrggbb", or "#rrggbbaa" with `alpha` when the color isn't opaque, as a native color input's is. It takes "#rgb" and "#rgba" too, and anything else is taken as "#000000", as a native color input takes it. Like a native input's `value`, the attribute is the default and the property is the current value.

Each thumb holds a visually hidden range input, which is what's focused and what a screenreader reads. A range input is what screenreaders on phones know how to adjust, with a swipe up or down, which they can't do to a `[role=slider]`. The area's input is its saturation, and its value text is its saturation and brightness. Left and Right change saturation, and Up and Down change brightness. The area has a second input for its brightness, left out of the tab order since the arrow keys already change both, so a screenreader on a phone can swipe to it. Each input is named by `label` and its own label, so a screenreader reads "Fill Hue". The arrow keys step by one, Page Up and Page Down by a tenth, and Home and End go as far as they can. Drag a thumb, or press anywhere along a slider or the area to move it there.

The hex field commits on "change", when it's blurred or Enter is pressed, and goes back to `value` when what's typed isn't a color. `swatches` is a space-separated list of colors, shown as a listbox whose selected option is the swatch that's `value`. Selection follows focus.

Every color is a valid value, so it's never invalid on its own. For a rule of your own, such as enough contrast, call `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`. The validity message shows in its description, as on Text Field, once validity is reported: when focus leaves it, its form is submitted, or `reportValidity()` is called.

What makes a color picker a color picker is functional, so that's done here: the area is the hue from white to fully saturated, darkening toward black. The hue slider is the spectrum, the alpha slider is clear to opaque, and each thumb and swatch is placed and colored. Give the area and the sliders a size, and style the rest through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(dragging)` and `:state(error)`. A thumb isn't focused itself, so one whose input has visible focus has a `focus-visible` part for a focus ring. The container sets `--color-picker-hue`, `--color-picker-opaque` and `--color-picker-value`, and each swatch `--color-picker-swatch`, for styles of your own.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default     | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | --------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |             | Names the group. Each control is named by it and its own label.                                                               |
| `alpha`            | `boolean` | `false`     | Adds the alpha slider, and `value` is "#rrggbbaa" when the color isn't opaque.                                                |
| `alpha-label`      | `string`  |             | Names the alpha slider, after `label`. "Alpha" in English when unset.                                                         |
| `area-label`       | `string`  |             | Names the area, after `label`. "Saturation and brightness" in English when unset.                                             |
| `brightness-label` | `string`  |             | Read before the area's brightness. "Brightness" in English when unset.                                                        |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false`     | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted. |
| `hex-label`        | `string`  |             | Names the hex field, after `label`. "Hex" in English when unset.                                                              |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean` | `false`     | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.              |
| `hue-label`        | `string`  |             | Names the hue slider, after `label`. "Hue" in English when unset.                                                             |
| `name`             | `string`  | `''`        | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                          |
| `saturation-label` | `string`  |             | Read before the area's saturation. "Saturation" in English when unset.                                                        |
| `swatches`         | `string`  | `''`        | Space-separated colors to pick from. Ones that aren't colors are left out.                                                    |
| `swatches-label`   | `string`  |             | Names the swatches, after `label`. "Swatches" in English when unset.                                                          |
| `value`            | `string`  | `'#000000'` | Like a native input's `value`, the attribute is the default and the property is the current value. "#000000" when unset.      |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `defaultValue`                  | `string`                  | The value it starts with, and goes back to when its form resets. It's the `value` attribute, as a native input's `defaultValue` is, so setting it sets the attribute, and `value` with it. |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `labels` (read-only)            | `NodeList`                | The `<label>` elements associated with it, as a native control's `labels`: each `<label for>` that names its `id`, and a `<label>` around it.                                              |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`. Empty while it's valid.                                                      |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                                                |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                                          |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                   |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                               |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.   |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                     |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                    |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`. |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `input`   | `Event` | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.               |
| `change`  | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.             |
| `invalid` | `Event` | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown. |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description` | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                           |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alpha`            | The alpha slider's track                                              |
| `alpha-thumb`      | The alpha slider's thumb                                              |
| `area`             | The saturation and brightness area                                    |
| `area-thumb`       | The area's thumb                                                      |
| `container`        | The label, the controls and the description                           |
| `description`      | Text about the color picker, and its validity message when it has one |
| `focus-visible`    | The thumb whose input has visible focus                               |
| `hex`              | The text input for the color as a hex code                            |
| `hue`              | The hue slider's track                                                |
| `hue-thumb`        | The hue slider's thumb                                                |
| `label`            | The label                                                             |
| `selected`         | The swatch that's value                                               |
| `swatch`           | A swatch                                                              |
| `swatches`         | The swatches                                                          |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid             |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(dragging)` | While the user drags a thumb.                                                                                             |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
